agenda_items.title: Demonstration of Amazon Quick (AI Pintar Dokumen) for auto-filling MOF document templates
agenda_items.summary: Paper Labs demonstrated the Amazon Quick AI agent, which uses uploaded ITBM/knowledge-base documents to auto-fill Word/Excel memo templates. The agent first needs context of the source document before it can populate a target template.

agenda_items.title: Data security and cloud processing concerns
agenda_items.summary: Team discussed how uploaded documents are processed via the cloud but not permanently stored or used for external model training. Data classification levels (public, confidential, secret) affect what can be uploaded.

agenda_items.title: Use of dummy/masked data for demonstration purposes
agenda_items.summary: Because some information (e.g., director's fees) is sensitive and not publicly available, the team agreed to mask or use dummy data for demo purposes, while publicly available data (e.g., financial statements) could be used as-is.

agenda_items.title: Comparison of Amazon Quick with Gemini Enterprise and ChatGPT
agenda_items.summary: The team compared Amazon Quick's agent-based customization capability against Gemini Enterprise and ChatGPT, noting Quick's advantage in being trainable for a specific use-case (memo/document generation) versus general-purpose chat tools.

agenda_items.title: Handling of missing information and manual completion workflow
agenda_items.summary: Discussion on how the AI highlights missing fields (e.g., 'SSX' placeholders) in yellow when data is unavailable in the source document, requiring manual prompting or officer input to complete.

agenda_items.title: AGM memo template standardization and notice requirements
agenda_items.summary: Team discussed how AGM memo templates remain structurally fixed across companies but content (e.g., director retirement notices, CVs, dates) varies and must be manually verified by officers.

agenda_items.title: Next steps: trial, training and desensitized document sharing
agenda_items.summary: Team agreed on next steps including running an internal experiment, organizing a training/immersion session, and using desensitized documents shared by MOF for further fine-tuning of the tool.

decisions.statement: Team agreed to use masked/dummy data for sensitive fields (e.g., director's fees) while using publicly available data (e.g., financial statements) as-is for the demo.
Agreed that any document deemed safe and non-sensitive by Puan (excluding high-level architecture documents) can be shared for trial purposes.
Agreed to proceed with the trial process involving Encik Baik and top management using desensitized data first.
Agreed that each user will be registered with an individual email account to access the Quick/Kuit extension.
Agreed to prepare a blank fillable table/template as a bridge for officers to manually input variable data before it is fed into Word documents.
Agreed to conduct an internal experiment first before proceeding further with implementation.
